overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the North Dakota State University Bison football team for winning the 2024 NCAA Division I Football Championship Subdivision (FCS) title, beating Montana State 35 to 32 on January 6, 2025, in Frisco, Texas. It notes the program's 18 national football titles, including 10 of the 14 FCS titles from 2011 to 2024, and that head coach Tim Polasek won the title in his first season. It commends the players, coaches, university leaders, students, and fans. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 15, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution rightly honors a historic college football program and the pride it brings to North Dakota.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
